messages:
Rina Kapoor: Dropping the latest mock for the API keys list. Main goals: clearer affordances for rotate/revoke, more helpful empty states, and fixes for show-secret accessibility. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc
Diego Alvarez: First glance looks cleaner. UX suggestion: surface 'Rotate key' as an inline action when the user has permission instead of hiding it in the kebab. Saves a click during audits.
Maya Singh: Accessibility notes: current show/hide toggle needs proper keyboard semantics (space/enter) and screen reader label that changes to 'Hide secret'/'Show secret'. Also ensure copying the key announces success via aria-live.
Tom Brooks: Revoke flow: suggest stronger hierarchy in the modal. Header: 'Revoke API key'. Lead sentence: 'This will immediately stop all requests using this key.' Then a secondary explanatory line: 'To restore access, generate a new key and update services.' Include an optional checkbox: 'Also remove from active sessions' for orgs who want session purge.
audit-bot: Auto-scan: danger button contrast low in dark theme (AA fail). Also modal close button lacks aria-label. Recommend adding aria-label="Close dialog".
Rina Kapoor: Agree on inline rotate. Can we add a tiny permission chip in the row: 'rotate: Org Admin' in muted text? Visible only if user has role or the viewer is an admin. Keeps list compact.
Diego Alvarez: If we add chips, keep them one-line. Use overflow ellipsis and don't increase row height. Maybe show on hover the full permission text.
Maya Singh: For screen readers, the chip should be exposed as text with aria-label like 'Permission: rotate required - Organization administrator'. Do not make it tabbable unless it's interactive.
Tom Brooks: Regarding undo after revoke 94 nice to have: show toast with 'Revoke successful. Undo' and keep a 20s server-side rollback option if supported. Otherwise update copy to avoid implying reversibility.
Rina Kapoor: Empty state proposed copy: 'Create your first API key to call Redwood APIs.' Below that a compact, copyable snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health` plus a CTA 'Learn about scopes'. Keep the snippet single-line and include a small copy icon with aria-label="Copy curl example".
Diego Alvarez: Also add a small 'Last used' column; helps triage stale keys before revoking. If privacy concerns, show 'Last used: 2 days ago' or 'Never used'.
Maya Singh: Modal accessibility checklist: 1) role="dialog" and aria-modal="true"; 2) initial focus on primary button; 3) focus return to initiating element; 4) announcement for success/failure via aria-live. I'll add these to the component PR.
Tom Brooks: Copy tweaks I'll draft: more direct revoke text, short danger CTA 'Revoke key', and secondary 'Rotate key' label. Also provide a compact tooltip on rotate describing what changes (rotates secret, existing tokens invalidated).
Rina Kapoor: Action owners: Diego -> row action placement + last-used column; Maya -> a11y modal & show-secret checklist; Tom -> modal copy + toast wording; Me (Rina) -> update figma and add a dev ticket for rollback/undo feasibility.
Diego Alvarez: I'll push layout tweaks by EOD PST.
Maya Singh: I'll add automated axe checks to the PR pipeline and link them in description.
Tom Brooks: I'll post copy variants and example toasts for review.
Rina Kapoor: Thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the copy or a11y labels ping me.
